title: Separation between data and instructions
invariant: Lower-trust content does not change instructions, permissions or the authorized purpose.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Confidentiality
invariant: Protected data are visible only to authorized identities and channels.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Isolation
invariant: Sessions, tenants and environments do not access resources outside their authorized domain.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Memory integrity
invariant: Memory writes and reads preserve the provenance, scope and validity of instructions.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Effective authorization
invariant: The authenticated identity and a policy external to the model limit object, action and properties.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Revocation and deletion
invariant: No route serves revoked content after the agreed deadline.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Knowledge provenance
invariant: Untrusted content does not acquire authority without validation and traceability.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Retrieval integrity
invariant: Selection and ranking do not allow protected decisions to be altered through untrusted sources.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Decision support
invariant: A claim or citation is validated against evidence before a protected decision.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Safe consumption
invariant: Generated data are not interpreted as executable syntax outside the consumer's contract.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Bounded execution
invariant: Only registered capabilities and validated arguments reach the isolated executor.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Intent and approval
invariant: Effects match the authorized task and an approval bound to arguments and resources.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Budget and stopping
invariant: Requests, steps, costs, time and actions stay within measured limits.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Effect uniqueness
invariant: Retries and concurrency do not duplicate the same logical operation.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Delegated scope
invariant: Delegation preserves identity, restrictions and accountability without expanding privileges.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Trust in MCP capabilities
invariant: Server metadata, changes and collisions do not expand the host's authority.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Per-recipient credentials
invariant: Every token is validated for issuer, audience, validity and the permissions of the receiving resource.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Session binding
invariant: A session does not replace authentication or allow mixing users or events.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Egress channels
invariant: Every destination, redirect and sent data item satisfies the egress policy.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Data admission
invariant: Adversarial data changes do not alter protected properties without detection and treatment.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Artifact integrity
invariant: Only approved and verifiable artifacts are loaded or deployed.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Loading without implicit code
invariant: Untrusted data/models do not enable code or executable formats outside approval.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Approved dependencies
invariant: The provenance and version of every dependency are verified before admission.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Controlled deployment
invariant: Only authorized, non-revoked revisions are admitted; recovery is verifiable.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Model privacy
invariant: Responses do not allow recovering or inferring protected data above the agreed threshold.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Evaluable policy
invariant: The response and the action satisfy an explicit policy measured with a rubric and benign controls.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Specific consent
invariant: Consent identifies the client, permissions, action and destination; it is not improperly inherited.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Detection and recovery
invariant: Critical events are correlated, detected and contained within agreed objectives.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Evaluation integrity
invariant: The evaluated system does not control the oracle, the test set or the evidence of its own result.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Multimodal transformation
invariant: Extraction and normalization preserve trust boundaries between modalities.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.

title: Traceable assessment
invariant: Every applicable obligation has an owner, activity, evidence or explicit exception.
owner_role: Owner of the component that enforces the boundary; the assessor verifies.
